heading: Connection, curiosity, and self-compassion
intro: Healing happens through relationship — not a clinical checklist. Here's what that looks like in our work together.

cards.title: Connection
cards.text: Real change starts in a relationship where you feel truly heard. Our sessions are a warm, collaborative space, built around you.

cards.title: Curiosity
cards.text: Together we get curious about the patterns that keep you stuck, and how past experience may be showing up in your life today.

cards.title: Self-Compassion
cards.text: Growth isn't about fixing what's broken. It's meeting yourself with understanding as you build new ways forward.

transitionsText: Change is rarely simple. Whatever transition brought you here, I'll walk alongside you as you find your footing.
ctaHeading: See how this looks in practice
ctaText: Individual, couples, and family therapy — explore the ways we can work together.
